prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 40s silver fox goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, silver-white sleek straight hair falling past her shoulders — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 chevron-shaped bands by 2 hazy transition zones, each shaped like a V pointing down with straight sides: each zone runs from one side edge of her figure sloping downward to the centre line, where it forms the tip of the V, then continues sloping upward to the opposite side edge. The tips of the V shapes sit about 44% of the way down her figure from the top, about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first V-shaped transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the chevron band between V-shaped zone 1 and V-shaped zone 2: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. Region 3 is everything below the last V-shaped transition zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but jellyfish bioluminescence formations in ELECTRIC CYAN and MAGENTA glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
